title: New transient accommodations tax collection software
summary: Finance plans an all-counties meeting with the state Department of Taxation next month. The deputy director said the new software for collecting the transient accommodation tax (TAT), a tax on short-term lodging, is on schedule and a week ahead. It is set to go live in October.
